prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama wins the 2012 US presidential election and is re-elected. The Mercury retrograde beginning on Election Day (6 November 2012) is read as a signature of recounts, delays and a result that revisits/repeats the existing state of affairs rather than a clean transfer of power — the incumbent is returned, though the count and the calling of the result may be messy and slow. Timing coordinate: the general election of 6 November 2012 given on the card.
basis: No tradition/system field appears on this card; the question is a mundane-astrology election call and is decided on that basis, in my own judgment. Card facts: incumbent Obama versus presumptive nominee Romney, competitive polling, Mercury retrograde beginning on election day. In mundane election reading, a Mercury retrograde opening on the vote favours the status quo being re-affirmed after confusion (the 'repeat/return' signature) over an untried replacement, and it warns of disputed or delayed counting rather than a decisive change of government; incumbency itself is the stronger mundane anchor in a close race. No natal data for either candidate is given on the card, so no invented chart factors are used. Prediction is stated as a single final direction (Obama re-elected) with the retrograde's messiness attached to the process, not as a second direction.
